tools.name: check_cves
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a CVE is exploited, how severe it is, or which vulnerabilities to patch first ("is CVE-… exploited", "prioritise these CVEs", "KEV status", "EPSS score"). Pass up to 20 CVE IDs (or text containing them). Returns CISA KEV status, EPSS, CVSS, SSVC and a sorted verdi

tools.name: recent_kev
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which vulnerabilities CISA recently added to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, optionally for one vendor or product ("new KEV entries this week", "exploited Microsoft vulnerabilities this month", "ransomware-linked CVEs").
